tasks.name: Observer-relative closure classification
tasks.abstention_contract: An abstention is encoded as outcome UNVERIFIABLE with a stated missing-baseline reason; silent omission is an error.

metrics.name: macro F1
metrics.definition: Unweighted mean of per-class F1 over the preregistered closure label set; absent support is reported, not dropped.

metrics.name: case exact match
metrics.definition: Fraction of cases with the exact outcome and exact required reason-code set.

metrics.name: unsafe positive-closure rate
metrics.definition: Fraction of non-closed oracle cases predicted CLOSED or CLOSED_WITH_EXCEPTIONS.

tasks.name: Observable obligation-baseline reconstruction
tasks.abstention_contract: If visible inputs cannot authenticate a complete observer-relative baseline, emit UNVERIFIABLE rather than guessing hidden obligations.

metrics.name: obligation set F1
metrics.definition: Set F1 over canonical obligation tuples after identifier-normalized matching.

metrics.name: baseline verifiability accuracy
metrics.definition: Accuracy of VERIFIABLE versus UNVERIFIABLE against the observer-relative oracle.

tasks.name: Evidence admissibility and defect diagnosis
input_contract: public key and anchor material released to the observer
tasks.abstention_contract: Unavailable verification material must yield INSUFFICIENT with an explicit reason and must not be treated as valid evidence.

metrics.name: admissibility macro F1
metrics.definition: Macro F1 across ADMISSIBLE, REJECTED, and INSUFFICIENT receipt outcomes.

metrics.name: precedence-aware reason accuracy
metrics.definition: Fraction whose primary defect equals the first applicable reason in the frozen rejection precedence.

tasks.name: Adversary detection with indistinguishability
tasks.abstention_contract: Observer-equivalent worlds must be labelled INDISTINGUISHABLE; accusing an attack without differentiating evidence is a false accusation.

metrics.name: detection balanced accuracy
metrics.definition: Mean recall over DETECTED, NOT_DETECTED, and INDISTINGUISHABLE classes.

metrics.name: indistinguishable-pair false accusation rate
metrics.definition: Fraction of known observer-equivalent pairs incorrectly labelled DETECTED.

tasks.name: Minimal closure repair explanation
input_contract: system output for PBE-T1 through PBE-T3

output_contract.repair_actions: ordered array from the public edit vocabulary

tasks.abstention_contract: If no observer-justified repair exists, return an empty action list and the reason REQUIRES_ADDITIONAL_VISIBILITY.

metrics.name: repair validity
metrics.definition: Fraction of proposed repairs that produce the claimed outcome when replayed by the sealed evaluator.

metrics.name: repair excess edit distance
metrics.definition: Proposed edit count minus sealed minimum among valid observer-permitted repairs.

tasks.name: Correctness-gated resource efficiency
prohibited_inputs: network services not declared by the adapter
tasks.abstention_contract: Efficiency is descriptive and ineligible for ranking when the system fails the preregistered correctness floor.

metrics.name: median and p95 case latency
metrics.definition: Steady-state wall-clock milliseconds per case after the fixed warm-up, reported with the environment manifest.

metrics.name: peak resident set size
metrics.definition: Maximum resident bytes of the isolated baseline process tree during the measured run.

tasks.eligibility_note: A system must meet the frozen PBE-T1 unsafe-close ceiling and task-specific validity gate before resource numbers are compared.

external_baselines.name: Open Policy Agent observer-rule baseline

adapter_contract.input_projection: Convert only the released observer bundle and public policy tables to canonical JSON input.
adapter_contract.output_mapping: Map the Rego decision object to the exact PaEBench task schema without post-hoc label correction.
adapter_contract.failure_mapping: Undefined, malformed, or timed-out decisions become explicit task errors, never negative labels.

fairness_controls: Rego rules may use training and development cases only
rule and data bundles are frozen before the sealed test split is opened
the same evaluation timestamp and public schema are supplied to every system
external_baselines.capability_boundary: OPA evaluates declared rules over supplied JSON; it does not authenticate receipts, discover wholly hidden lineage, or prove storage erasure.

external_baselines.name: W3C PROV plus SHACL lineage-validation baseline

adapter_contract.input_projection: Translate observer-visible custody and derivation edges to PROV-O RDF and apply frozen SHACL shapes.
adapter_contract.output_mapping: Map SHACL focus nodes and result paths to obligation tuples and public PaEBench defect codes.
adapter_contract.failure_mapping: Parser failures, unsupported datatypes, and timeouts are task errors; non-conformance is reported only from SHACL results.

fairness_controls: RDF mapping and SHACL shapes are frozen on training and development cases
hidden nodes and evaluator-only edges are never materialized into the RDF graph
entailment mode and inference settings are pinned in the environment manifest
external_baselines.capability_boundary: SHACL validates graph constraints exposed in the observer projection; it cannot infer undisclosed recipients or establish cryptographic receipt authenticity.

external_baselines.name: Sigstore Rekor transparency-verification baseline

adapter_contract.input_projection: Encode released receipt attestations in the frozen Rekor entry format and use a benchmark-local log and trust root.
adapter_contract.output_mapping: Map signature, inclusion, consistency, and integrated-time checks to the public evidence-defect taxonomy.
adapter_contract.failure_mapping: Missing inclusion or consistency material maps to INSUFFICIENT; invalid cryptographic material maps to REJECTED.

fairness_controls: all systems receive the same benchmark-local trust root and released verification material
no public Sigstore service is contacted during evaluation
the log snapshot and container digest are frozen before measurement
external_baselines.capability_boundary: Rekor establishes properties of signed log entries and append-only inclusion; it does not establish that the attested deletion occurred or that all obligations were discovered.

external_baselines.name: OPA plus PROV-SHACL plus Rekor component composition

adapter_contract.input_projection: Fan out the same observer projection to the three frozen component adapters with no extra fields.
adapter_contract.output_mapping: Feed Rekor and SHACL results to a frozen OPA combining policy and map its decision to PaEBench outputs.
adapter_contract.failure_mapping: Component uncertainty propagates conservatively; unavailable required material cannot be converted to a positive closure.

fairness_controls: component versions and the combining policy are frozen before sealed-test evaluation
only public component outputs enter the combining policy
no component is credited outside the tasks its native capability supports
external_baselines.capability_boundary: This is a strongest-component composition, not a claim that the upstream projects implement federated erasure verification or endorse the adapter.

independent_use_cases.title: Clinical research consent withdrawal across care and research custodians
independent_use_cases.independence_claim: This profile is domain-separated from the smart-grid catalogue and uses health-exchange concepts that were not used to construct the seven canonical energy scenarios. It is a transfer test, not a statistically independent human-authored replication.

variants.perturbation: add contradictory terminal evidence for XD-HR-O-LAB

independent_use_cases.title: Multi-tenant SaaS offboarding with search, analytics, backup, and billing copies
independent_use_cases.independence_claim: This profile is domain-separated from energy infrastructure and stresses software-service copies, subprocessors, indexes, and bounded billing retention. It is a transfer test, not a statistically independent human-authored replication.

variants.perturbation: retain invoice under a time-bounded declared exception
conflict backup key-destruction time with signed key-use evidence

independent_use_cases.title: Training-data withdrawal across feature, checkpoint, embedding, and serving stores
independent_use_cases.independence_claim: This profile is domain-separated from transaction and meter workflows and stresses derived model artefacts whose acceptable disposition is policy-specific. It is a transfer test, not a claim that deletion from a trained model is universally solved.

variants.perturbation: replace affected checkpoint with policy-approved retrained artefact
present conflicting checkpoint lineage and retraining attestations

evaluation_tracks.name: Canonical smart-grid and adversarial evaluation
evaluation_tracks.tuning_policy: Training and development partitions may be used; sealed test labels remain evaluator-only.

evaluation_tracks.name: Sealed cross-domain transfer evaluation
evaluation_tracks.tuning_policy: No rule, prompt, mapping, threshold, or code change is permitted after any cross-domain observer bundle is opened.
